items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, he suggested it, and showed me how to do it, too; he came over to the drums and showed me how it was done

ctx.x: It is so simple; it is so simple that you wouldn't believe it. All I played was just straight quarter notes. He sang said ... "It brings me tears" -- chat's all I played with those brushes. Because if you remember, in the church, that was the way the mothers used to keep the babies quiet on their knees when they were singing; all they did was lift their foot and then drop it -- just a straight 4-4, that's all they were doing, and the baby, they'd be patting the baby and they'd go right back to sleep. And that's…
Yeah, he suggested it, and showed me how to do it, too; he came over to the drums and showed me how it was done, and I did it, and I was really thrilled about that.
